stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> DraftChat
DraftChat: Workflow editable, local draft
DraftChat --> StartPending: first Send
StartPending --> DraftChat: rejected, retain draft
StartPending --> ActiveIdle: RunStarted, workflow locked
ActiveIdle --> Busy: OperationStarted
Busy --> QueuePending: Queue input
QueuePending --> BusyQueued: InputQueued
QueuePending --> Busy: rejected, retain draft
BusyQueued --> Busy: QueuedInputDequeued
Busy --> PausePending: Pause
PausePending --> Paused: RunPaused
PausePending --> Busy: rejected
Paused --> Busy: Resume and OperationStarted
Busy --> CancelPending: Cancel
BusyQueued --> CancelPending: Cancel
Paused --> CancelPending: Cancel
CancelPending --> Terminal: RunCancelled
ActiveIdle --> Terminal: Completed or Failed
Busy --> Terminal: Completed or Failed
BusyQueued --> Terminal: Completed or Failed
Terminal: ordinary input disabled, inspect, retry, fork, continue
DraftChat --> Stale: gap or disconnect
StartPending --> Stale: gap or disconnect
ActiveIdle --> Stale: gap or disconnect
Busy --> Stale: gap or disconnect
BusyQueued --> Stale: gap or disconnect
Paused --> Stale: gap or disconnect
Stale: preserve unsent draft, disable state changes
Stale --> DraftChat: resync not started
Stale --> ActiveIdle: resync waiting
Stale --> Busy: resync active
Stale --> BusyQueued: resync queued
Stale --> Paused: resync paused
Stale --> Terminal: resync terminal
